chapterInfo.content:
13
Asotwe ho asɛnka
1Saa berɛ no ara na nnipa bi a wɔwɔ hɔ kaa Galileafoɔ a Pilato de wɔn mogya frafraa wɔn afɔdeɛ mu ho asɛm kyerɛɛ no. 2#Yoh 9.2 Na ɔbua see wɔn sɛ: Mosusu sɛ Galileafoɔ yi hunuu saa amaneɛ yi nti na wɔyɛ nnebɔneyɛfoɔ sene Galileafoɔ nyinaa? 3#Dwom 7.12 Mese mo sɛ: Ɛnte saa, na mmom sɛ moansakyera mo adwene a, mo nyinaa bɛyera saa ara. 4Anaasɛ nnipa dunwɔtwe a Siloa abantenten no bu hwee wɔn so na ɛkumm wɔn no, mosusu sɛ wɔyɛ nnebɔneyɛfoɔ sene nnipa a wɔte Yerusalem nyinaa? 5Mese mo sɛ: Ɛnte saa, na mmom sɛ moansakyera mo adwene a, mo nyinaa bɛyera saa ara.
Borɔdɔma a ɛnso aba
6 # Mat 21.19 Na ɔbuu wɔn bɛ yi sɛ: Obi wɔ borɔdɔma a wadua wɔ ne bobe turom; na ɔba bɛhwehwɛɛ so aba, na wannya bi. 7Na ɔka kyerɛɛ turomhwɛfoɔ no sɛ: Hwɛ, mfirinhyia mmiɛnsa ni a maba mabɛhwehwɛ borɔdɔma yi so aba, na mannya bie. Twa twene! Adɛn nti na agye asase no akɛntɛne soɔ? 8#2 Pe 3.9; 3.15 Na ɔbua see no sɛ: Owura, ma no nsi hɔ afe yi nso nkɔsi sɛ mɛfunifuni ho na magu aseɛ sumina. 9Na ebia ɛbɛso; na sɛ anso ansa a, woatwa atwene.
Homeda bi ayaresa
10Na ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ hyiadan bi mu homeda. 11Na hwɛ, na ɔbaa bi wɔ hɔ a ɔwɔ ahoɔmmerɛ honhom mfirinhyia dunwɔtwe, na wapono a ɔntumi ntene ne mu koraa mpo. 12Na Yesu hunuu no no, ɔfrɛɛ no, na ɔsee no sɛ: Ɔbaa wɔasane wo afiri w’ahoɔmmerɛ mu. 13#Mar 7.32 Na ɔde ne nsa guu ne so, na amonom hɔ ara ɔtenee, na ɔyii Onyankopɔn ayɛ. 14Na hyiadan no mu panin a ɛyɛɛ no ahi sɛ Yesu saa yadeɛ homeda no bua see nkurɔfokuo no sɛ: Nnansia wɔ hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ nnipa yɛ adwuma; emu na mommra na wɔnsa mo yadeɛ, na ɛnyɛ homeda. 15#Luka 14.5 Na Awurade buaa no sɛ: Nyaatwomfoɔ! Mo mu biara nsane ne nantwie anaa n’afunumu mfiri n’adididaka ho mma no nkɔnom nsuo homeda? 16#Luka 19.9 Na hwɛ, ɔbaa yi a ɔyɛ Abraham babaa a Satan akyekyere no mfirinhyia dunwɔtwe yi, ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔsane no firi kyekyerɛ yi mu homeda? 17Na ɔkaa saa no, n’atamfoɔ no nyinaa ani wuiɛ, na nkurɔfokuo no nyinaa ani gyee animuonyam adeɛ a ɔyɛeɛ no nyinaa nti.
Sinapi aba ne mmɔka ho bɛ
(Mateo 13.31-33; Marko 4.30-32)
18Na ɔkaa sɛ: Adeɛ bɛn na Nyankopɔn ahennie sɛ no anaasɛ ɛdeɛn ho na mede bɛtoɔ? 19Ɛte sɛ sinapi fua a onipa fa kɔduaa wɔ ne turom; na ɛnyinii, na ɛyɛɛ dua, na ewiem nnomaa bɛsisii ne mman so. 20Na ɔkaa bio sɛ: Ɛdeɛn ho na mede Nyankopɔn ahennie bɛtoɔ? 21Ɛte sɛ mmɔka a ɔbaa bi fa kɔfetee no esiam nkorokuma mmiɛnsa mu de kɔsii sɛ ne nyinaa kaeɛ.
Ɛpono teateaa no
(Mateo 7.13, 14, 21-23)
22Na ɔnenam nkuro mu ne nkuraa ase rekyerɛkyerɛ, na na ɔnam so rekɔ Yerusalem. 23Na obi bisaa no sɛ: Awurade, wɔn a wɔbɛgye wɔn yɛ kakraa bi anaa? 24#Mat 7.13-14; Flp 3.12 Na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Mompere nhyɛne ɛpono teateaa no mu! Na mese mo sɛ: Nnipa pii bɛhwehwɛ mu ahyɛne, na wɔrentumi. 25#Mat 25.11-12 Ɛfiri berɛ a efiewura no bɛsɔre ato pono mu no ara na mobɛfiri aseɛ agyina akyire, na moabɔ ɛpono no mu sɛ: Owura, hini yɛn! Na ɔbɛbua mo sɛ: Mo deɛ, mennim deɛ mofire. 26#Mat 7.22-23 Ɛnna mobɛfiri aseɛ aka sɛ: Yɛadidi na yɛanom w’anim, na woakyerɛkyerɛ wɔ yɛn mmɔntene so pɛn. 27Na ɔbɛka sɛ: Mo deɛ, mennim deɛ mofire. Momfiri me so, mo a moyɛ deɛ ɛntene nyinaa! 28Ɛhɔ na mobɛsu atwɛre mo se sɛ mohunu Abraham, Isak ne Yakob ne adiyifoɔ no nyinaa Nyankopɔn ahennie mu, na mo deɛ, wɔapam mo afiri mu. 29#Luka 14.15 Na wɔbɛfiri apueeɛ, atɔeɛ, atifi ne anafoɔ aba abɛtena adidiiɛ Nyankopɔn ahennie mu. 30#Mat 19.30 Na hwɛ, akyikafoɔ bi wɔ hɔ a wɔbɛdi kan, na adikanfoɔ bi wɔ hɔ a wɔbɛka akyire.
Herode Antipa
31Dɔn no ara mu na Farisifoɔ bi ba bɛsee no sɛ: Firi ha kɔ! Na Herode repɛ wo aku wo. 32Na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Monkɔka nkyerɛ sakraman no sɛ: Hwɛ, metu ahonhommɔne, na mesa yadeɛ nnɛ ne ɔkyena, ne n’adekyeeɛ na mawie.
Yesu twa Yerusalem ho adwo
(Mateo 23.37-39)
33 Nanso ɛsɛ sɛ menante nnɛ ne ɔkyena ne n’adekyeeɛ; na ɛnni ho kwan sɛ odiyifoɔ bi bɛtɔ baabi, gye Yerusalem. 34O Yerusalem, Yerusalem a wokum adiyifoɔ na wosii wɔn a wɔsomaa wɔn wo nkyɛn no aboɔ! Mprɛ ahe nie a mepɛɛ sɛ meboaboa wo mma ano sɛ akokɔbaatan boaboa ne mma ano ne ntaban aseɛ, nanso moampɛ. 35#Dwom 118.26 Hwɛ, wɔbɛgya mo fie fituo ama mo. Na mese mo sɛ: Morenhu me, gye da a ɛbɛba sɛ mobɛka sɛ: Nhyira ne deɛ ɔnam Awurade din mu reba no!

Saa berɛ no ara na nnipa bi a wɔwɔ hɔ kaa Galileafoɔ a Pilato de wɔn mogya frafraa wɔn afɔdeɛ mu ho asɛm kyerɛɛ no. Anaasɛ nnipa dunwɔtwe a Siloa abantenten no bu hwee wɔn so na ɛkumm wɔn no, mosusu sɛ wɔyɛ nnebɔneyɛfoɔ sene nnipa a wɔte Yerusalem nyinaa? Mese mo sɛ: Ɛnte saa, na mmom sɛ moansakyera mo adwene a, mo nyinaa bɛyera saa ara.

Na ɔbuu wɔn bɛ yi sɛ: Obi wɔ borɔdɔma a wadua wɔ ne bobe turom; na ɔba bɛhwehwɛɛ so aba, na wannya bi. Na ɔka kyerɛɛ turomhwɛfoɔ no sɛ: Hwɛ, mfirinhyia mmiɛnsa ni a maba mabɛhwehwɛ borɔdɔma yi so aba, na mannya bie. Twa twene! Adɛn nti na agye asase no akɛntɛne soɔ? Na ɔbua see no sɛ: Owura, ma no nsi hɔ afe yi nso nkɔsi sɛ mɛfunifuni ho na magu aseɛ sumina. Na ebia ɛbɛso; na sɛ anso ansa a, woatwa atwene.

Na ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ hyiadan bi mu homeda. Na hwɛ, na ɔbaa bi wɔ hɔ a ɔwɔ ahoɔmmerɛ honhom mfirinhyia dunwɔtwe, na wapono a ɔntumi ntene ne mu koraa mpo. Na Yesu hunuu no no, ɔfrɛɛ no, na ɔsee no sɛ: Ɔbaa wɔasane wo afiri w’ahoɔmmerɛ mu. Na ɔde ne nsa guu ne so, na amonom hɔ ara ɔtenee, na ɔyii Onyankopɔn ayɛ. Na hyiadan no mu panin a ɛyɛɛ no ahi sɛ Yesu saa yadeɛ homeda no bua see nkurɔfokuo no sɛ: Nnansia wɔ hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ nnipa yɛ adwuma; emu na mommra na wɔnsa mo yadeɛ, na ɛnyɛ homeda. Na Awurade buaa no sɛ: Nyaatwomfoɔ! Mo mu biara nsane ne nantwie anaa n’afunumu mfiri n’adididaka ho mma no nkɔnom nsuo homeda? Na hwɛ, ɔbaa yi a ɔyɛ Abraham babaa a Satan akyekyere no mfirinhyia dunwɔtwe yi, ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔsane no firi kyekyerɛ yi mu homeda? Na ɔkaa saa no, n’atamfoɔ no nyinaa ani wuiɛ, na nkurɔfokuo no nyinaa ani gyee animuonyam adeɛ a ɔyɛeɛ no nyinaa nti.


Na ɔkaa sɛ: Adeɛ bɛn na Nyankopɔn ahennie sɛ no anaasɛ ɛdeɛn ho na mede bɛtoɔ? Ɛte sɛ sinapi fua a onipa fa kɔduaa wɔ ne turom; na ɛnyinii, na ɛyɛɛ dua, na ewiem nnomaa bɛsisii ne mman so. Na ɔkaa bio sɛ: Ɛdeɛn ho na mede Nyankopɔn ahennie bɛtoɔ? Ɛte sɛ mmɔka a ɔbaa bi fa kɔfetee no esiam nkorokuma mmiɛnsa mu de kɔsii sɛ ne nyinaa kaeɛ.


Na ɔnenam nkuro mu ne nkuraa ase rekyerɛkyerɛ, na na ɔnam so rekɔ Yerusalem. Na obi bisaa no sɛ: Awurade, wɔn a wɔbɛgye wɔn yɛ kakraa bi anaa? Na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Mompere nhyɛne ɛpono teateaa no mu! Na mese mo sɛ: Nnipa pii bɛhwehwɛ mu ahyɛne, na wɔrentumi. Ɛfiri berɛ a efiewura no bɛsɔre ato pono mu no ara na mobɛfiri aseɛ agyina akyire, na moabɔ ɛpono no mu sɛ: Owura, hini yɛn! Na ɔbɛbua mo sɛ: Mo deɛ, mennim deɛ mofire. Ɛnna mobɛfiri aseɛ aka sɛ: Yɛadidi na yɛanom w’anim, na woakyerɛkyerɛ wɔ yɛn mmɔntene so pɛn. Na ɔbɛka sɛ: Mo deɛ, mennim deɛ mofire. Momfiri me so, mo a moyɛ deɛ ɛntene nyinaa! Ɛhɔ na mobɛsu atwɛre mo se sɛ mohunu Abraham, Isak ne Yakob ne adiyifoɔ no nyinaa Nyankopɔn ahennie mu, na mo deɛ, wɔapam mo afiri mu. Dɔn no ara mu na Farisifoɔ bi ba bɛsee no sɛ: Firi ha kɔ! Na Herode repɛ wo aku wo. Na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Monkɔka nkyerɛ sakraman no sɛ: Hwɛ, metu ahonhommɔne, na mesa yadeɛ nnɛ ne ɔkyena, ne n’adekyeeɛ na mawie.


Nanso ɛsɛ sɛ menante nnɛ ne ɔkyena ne n’adekyeeɛ; na ɛnni ho kwan sɛ odiyifoɔ bi bɛtɔ baabi, gye Yerusalem. O Yerusalem, Yerusalem a wokum adiyifoɔ na wosii wɔn a wɔsomaa wɔn wo nkyɛn no aboɔ! Mprɛ ahe nie a mepɛɛ sɛ meboaboa wo mma ano sɛ akokɔbaatan boaboa ne mma ano ne ntaban aseɛ, nanso moampɛ. Hwɛ, wɔbɛgya mo fie fituo ama mo. Na mese mo sɛ: Morenhu me, gye da a ɛbɛba sɛ mobɛka sɛ: Nhyira ne deɛ ɔnam Awurade din mu reba no!

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
